results.name: Waneci

verification.notes: Waneci/Wanetsi (ISO 639-3 wne, Glottolog wane1241) is a Pashto dialect/language spoken primarily in Harnai District and the Chawter area of Sanjawi, northern Balochistan, Pakistan (Wikipedia: Wanetsi, Harnai District; Sinjawi Tehsil cites Hallberg 1992 'Pashto, Waneci, Ormuri', Sociolinguistic Survey of Northern Pakistan). Entry holds 30 seeds in field b (not 33 as previously assumed; max=30). Verified each seed against primary/Wikipedia sources. Confirmed real settlements in the Waneci area: Harnai (town/district HQ; Wikipedia Harnai, Harnai District); Shahrig/Shahrag (tehsil; Wikipedia Harnai District); Khost (town+UC; Wikipedia Khost Pakistan, Dawn); Sanjawi (tehsil HQ; Wikipedia Sinjawi Tehsil); Chawter (Wanetsi area/village; Wikipedia Wanetsi, Sinjawi Tehsil); Choutair/Chotair (Saddar Samalan/Ziarat navbox; Sinjawi Tehsil), Regorah/Regora (Sinjawi Tehsil village), Baghaw/Bghaow (Sinjawi Tehsil village; Saddar Samalan navbox), Poi (Saddar Samalan/Ziarat navbox), Poi Shareef (Sinjawi Tehsil village), Saddar Samalan (town+UC Ziarat District/Sanjawi Tehsil; Wikipedia Saddar Samalan), Uzhlaiz (Sinjawi Tehsil village), Chelaiz Khalil (Sinjawi Tehsil village), Tand Wani (Sinjawi Tehsil village; pakistanalmanac Ziarat), Shinlaiz (Sinjawi Tehsil village), Wam/Tor Waam (Sinjawi Tehsil village; Saddar Samalan navbox), Faran Tangi, Kach, Kawas, Sandman Tangi, Zandra (Saddar Samalan/Ziarat navbox; pakistanalmanac Ziarat). Harnai District Union Councils Saddar Harnai-I/II, Babihan-I/II, Nakus-I/II confirmed by Balochistan LG election 2022 results; Babihan/Nakus are towns (Wikipedia). Removed 3 unconfirmed/duplicate seeds: Chalez Khalil (not independently confirmed; spelling variant/duplicate of confirmed Chelaiz Khalil), Thanda Wani (variant of confirmed Tand Wani; not independently confirmed), Viallah Aghbarg ('Viallah' prefix unconfirmed; Aghbarg itself confirmed but not under this name). 27 confirmed seeds >= 25 floor -> verified.
